name: Startup Apps & Services Workflow
description: Verifies the Startup Apps and Services tabs: listing, search, sort, toggle/start/stop actions, and failure feedback.

planSteps.description: Assert launch agents/daemons resolve from ~/Library/LaunchAgents, /Library/LaunchAgents, and /Library/LaunchDaemons
Select a user-writable launch agent and click Disable
Assert the plist Disabled flag flips and the row reflects it
Select a system (root-owned) launch daemon and click Disable
Assert a user-visible error alert explains the item is not writable
Assert the launchctl list table renders Name, PID, and Status columns (Group column removed)
Click Stop on a system service
Assert the operation result is surfaced to the user via the action-error alert when it fails
